zoe-sales: Quick heads-up — Cedilla (prospect) wants to onboard a custom 13B Llama-compatible variant into our Private deployment for a POC. They specifically asked about: KMS integration, 8-bit quant support, KV-cache layout, and whether we can guarantee latency for their 256-token chat workload. Can ops/eng confirm feasibility?

raj-ml: thanks — main compatibility flags: tokenizer differences (custom bpe), rmsnorm vs layernorm ops, and kv-cache key layout. If their checkpoint follows a HF-state-dict shape we can usually convert. Do we have a quick conversion playbook?

maria-sre: @raj-ml @dan-eng we need the security side: will customer-managed KMS in Private be a showstopper? Cedilla requires CMK + audit logs.

dan-eng: CMK is supported in Private (via KMS passthrough) but requires config in the control-plane manifest and a small operator change for key wrapping. Ops effort ~1 day to enable for a new tenant. Latency-wise, 13B with q4_k_m or 8-bit dynamic quant usually hits ~60–80ms/token on our A10G pool for greedy decode at seq=256 with batching=1. For strict SLAs we recommend dedicated capacity.

zoe-sales: pricing question from the AE — if they take Private + reserved capacity, what's the uplift for dedicated throughput? ballpark we can give to the customer?

dan-eng: reserved capacity add-on is our standard uplift: +20–30% baseline infra fee for placement guarantee, then token/unit pricing separate. For a POC we'll often suggest a short-monthly commit to avoid full contract overhead. I'll sync with finance later.

raj-ml: for model onboarding steps: 1) customer uploads model checkpoint + tokenizer, 2) runtime conversion script runs (faiss/ggml->triton opt), 3) KV-cache layout validation (unit tests), 4) perf smoke with our test prompts, 5) optional quant sweep (q8_0 / q4_k_m). I can take (2)-(4) if we get artifacts.

selene-ps: @zoe-sales flagging an enterprise blocker: their legal wants an answered security questionnaire about data residency and key custody before POC starts. Leo-legal is looping in.

leo-legal: Received. Two notes: (a) need explicit confirmation that customer CMK never leaves their HSM keys and we store only wrapped keys; (b) we need export controls checklist for model artifacts (some variants reference restricted tokenizers). I'll draft a short reply template.

maria-sre: Also need tenant network diagram for Private (VPC peering / egress rules). Cedilla is on-prem-ish so might want air-gapped testing. We have an "on-prem POC checklist" we can share.

zoe-sales: customer asked if we can run a quick compatibility test using a 5–10 prompt smoke test before giving us the full model files. Is there a minimal artifact (e.g., model header + tokenizer.json) that would let you run the conversion smoke?

raj-ml: yes — minimal: tokenizer.json + model config + the first shard or a small distilled checkpoint (even just the embedding + lm_head slices). With that we can run a tokenizer confirm and shape checks. For perf we need a full shard but smoke-level sanity checks OK with partials.

dan-eng: I'll prepare a small script they can run locally that extracts model metadata and spits out a `compat_report.json`:

```
python tools/extract_model_metadata.py --checkpoint /path/to/ckpt --out meta.json
# returns: tokenization_hash, param_shapes, rmsnorm_flag, dtype
```

Send that to them and we can iterate.

zoe-sales: perfect. Action items: (1) I will ask Cedilla for tokenizer.json + model config + sample shard; (2) @raj-ml run conversion smoke when we get it; (3) @dan-eng estimate reserved capacity uplift and perf SLA; (4) @leo-legal provide template answers for KMS + export controls; (5) @maria-sre share on-prem POC checklist.

leo-legal: noted. I'll post the draft SQ template in this thread by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment hint — Private tenant creation ticket #T-9812 created (owner: dan-eng). Please update with model artifacts.

maria-sre: shared the checklist: https://internal.redwood/sops/pocs/onprem-checklist (includes network diagram examples and required logs retention settings).

raj-ml: quick note on quant: q4_k_m is usually our sweet spot for 13B in Private if customer accepts minor quality variance. If they need exact parity, we'll run a quality eval vs their prompt set (regression test).

zoe-sales: thanks team — I'll loop back to Cedilla with the extraction script & checklist and ask for the minimal artifacts. Will update this thread once they respond. :thumbsup:
